data_flow:
The section will trace the end-to-end Phase 4 planner loop data flow as built:
1. Scope capture (T1): A caller posts `scope.captured` to `POST /rooms/:roomId/events` with a `goal` string. `prepareFounderGoal` checks bounds and credential patterns, computes `founderGoalDigest(goal)`, attaches `{ kind: 'founder_goal', ref: event.eventId, digest }` to `evidence`, and stores `goal` in the room event payload (`packages/control-plane/src/founder-goal.ts` lines 47-72).
2. Round opening and journal-before-dispatch (T2): `PlannerLoop.runRound` (in `packages/control-plane/src/planner-loop.ts`) reads the room state under the fenced leader store. In `SCOPED`, it resolves the seat via `resolvePlannerSeat()`, verifies the route via `authorizeRoute`, computes `plannerCommandIdFor(roomId, openingEventId, 1)`, and in one Postgres transaction appends T2 `task.dispatched.planner` (deriving `rolesAssigned`, `reviewerIsNotBuilder`, and fence-backed `gatewayOnline` on the server) and writes the command's `journaled` row (`JournalStore.journalCommand`).
3. Gateway poll, attestation, and execution: `GatewayPlannerWorker` (`packages/gateway-daemon/src/planner-worker.ts`) polls `POST /gateway/planner/poll`. On `attest`, it queries `executor.attest(commandId)` and reports `{ role: 'architect', surface: 'antigravity', provider: 'google', model: 'gemini-4-argon', effort: 'high' }`; `PlannerLoop` verifies `role === 'architect'` and writes `identity_bound`. On `execute`, `PlannerRecordStore` writes a durable `accepted` record to `<gatewayDirectory>/planner/<sha256(commandId)>.json` before `AgyPlannerExecutor` verifies the root-owned `agy` binary SHA-256, prepares a read-only checkout at `baseSha` with `scopePaths`, spawns `sudo -n -u <plannerUser> -- <agyPath>` with `PINNED_AGY_ARGUMENTS`, waits for the first stream-json `init` line confirming `init.model === 'gemini-4-argon-high'` before writing the prompt to stdin, and extracts the single `plandoc/1` JSON object.
4. Init verification, plan judgment, and atomic T3 commit: `PlannerLoop` requires `PlannerInit` (`initModel` and `conversationId`) for `antigravity` + `google`, checks observed vs intended route, and writes `dispatched` carrying `init_model` and `provider_conversation_id`. When `awaitPlan` returns the raw document, `judgeRoundPlan` runs `judgePlanDoc` (`PLANDOC_SCHEMA_V1`, `checkScopePaths`, `work_id === commandId`, `repository`, `base_sha`, `terminal_status === 'PLAN_READY_FOR_FOUNDER_APPROVAL'`). `submitRoundPlan` then commits T3 `plan.submitted` (with `plan_bundle` evidence carrying `planHash`), `PlanStore.recordPlan` (`public.build_room_plans`), and the journal `completed` row (`result_digest = planHash`) in one transaction.
5. Plan read, Founder decision (T4/T5/T22), and revision or recovery: The Founder reads the plan via `GET /control-plane/rooms/:roomId/plan` and posts `plan.revision_requested` (T4), `plan.approved` (T5), or `founder.cancel` (T22) to `POST /control-plane/rooms/:roomId/plan-decision`, which commits the lifecycle event and `decision` journal row in one transaction. On T4, the next `PlannerLoop.runRound` in `PLANNING` loads the prior plan from `PlanStore`, verifies its `planHash` against T4's `revisingPlanHash`, and passes `earlierPlan` and `revisionFeedback` into the revision round.
trust_and_security_boundaries:
The `README.md` section will document the security boundaries enforced in code:
1. Runtime database role and append-only tables: `JournalStore` (`packages/control-plane/src/journal-store.ts` line 236) and `PlanStore` (`packages/control-plane/src/plan-store.ts`) run as `br_app_runtime`. `public.build_room_plans` (`0010_plan_store`, `packages/control-plane/src/migrations.ts` lines 1898-1915) forbids `UPDATE`, `DELETE`, and `TRUNCATE` and grants only `SELECT, INSERT` to `br_app_runtime`.
2. Governed event path enforcement: `POST /rooms/:roomId/events` rejects `GOVERNED_PATH_EVENTS` (`task.dispatched.planner`, `plan.submitted`, `plan.revision_requested`, `plan.approved`, `founder.cancel`) with `403 governed_path_required` (`packages/control-plane/src/server.ts` lines 236-239), preventing callers from forging server-derived guard facts (`rolesAssigned`, `reviewerIsNotBuilder`, `gatewayOnline`, `planHash`) or bypassing journal writes.
3. Token separation: `CONTROL_PLANE_TOKEN` guards room events and `GET /control-plane/rooms/:roomId/plan`; `PHASE3_ADJUDICATION_TOKEN` exclusively guards `POST /control-plane/rooms/:roomId/plan-decision`; `PHASE4_COUNTED_RUN_TOKEN` exclusively guards `/control-plane/rooms/:roomId/planner-round` and `/control-plane/rooms/:roomId/journal`. In `packages/control-plane/src/config.ts` (lines 321-334), `PHASE4_COUNTED_RUN_TOKEN` must differ from both `CONTROL_PLANE_TOKEN` and `PHASE3_ADJUDICATION_TOKEN`.
4. Pre-write redaction and value-redacted refusals: `prepareFounderGoal`, `PlanStore.recordPlan`, `plan-decision.ts`, and `JournalStore` reject credential material via `containsCredentialMaterial` / `scanRecordForCredentials`. When a planner output fails schema validation, `PlannerLoop` logs `planner.plan_refused` with value-redacted `PlanRefusalReason` diagnostics (`packages/control-plane/src/planner-loop.ts` lines 971-996) and never stores the refused body.
5. Isolated Linux planner execution: `AgyPlannerExecutor` (`packages/gateway-daemon/src/agy-planner-executor.ts`) runs only on Linux Gateway `1880c12d-d98d-4a91-b25a-23320aa7f58a`, verifies the root-owned `agy` binary SHA-256 before execution, withholds the prompt until `init.model === 'gemini-4-argon-high'` is observed, forbids tool commands (`run_command`, `write_file`, `edit_file`), reaps processes with `pkill -KILL -u <plannerUser>`, and writes `planner-halted.json` on any cleanup or probe failure.

error_and_failure_behavior:
The `README.md` section will summarize the fail-closed behaviors built into the Phase 4 planner loop:
1. Unfenced or non-leader control plane: `PlannerLoop` throws `PlannerLoopUnfencedError` if constructed without a fenced store (`packages/control-plane/src/planner-loop.ts` lines 435-443); `POST /control-plane/rooms/:roomId/plan-decision` and `POST /control-plane/rooms/:roomId/planner-round` run behind `requireLeader` (`packages/control-plane/src/server.ts` lines 460-476).
2. Pre-contact vs post-contact failures and retry budget: Only an affirmative `not_sent` transport failure may be retried within `DISPATCH_POLICY.transport_retries_max` (2 retries, up to `MAX_ROUND_ATTEMPTS = 3`), and only when `retryBudgetTransition` allows (`packages/control-plane/src/planner-loop.ts` lines 651-677, 868-899). Ambiguous outcomes, timeouts, route mismatches (`route_mismatch`), missing init evidence (`init_missing`), or rejected plans (`plan_rejected`) record `unresolved` in the journal with no automatic retry.
3. Gateway at-most-one discipline and executor halt: `PlannerRecordStore` (`packages/gateway-daemon/src/planner-worker.ts` lines 253-358) refuses a duplicate `execute` for any existing `commandId` and refuses `not_sent` unless both the worker record is absent and `executor.status(commandId)` reports `never_received`. If `AgyPlannerExecutor` cannot confirm a clean process table or workspace cleanup, it writes `planner-halted.json` and refuses subsequent runs until cleared.
4. Recovery before new dispatch: `PlannerRecovery.recoverRoom` (`packages/control-plane/src/planner-recovery.ts` lines 151-285) runs `journal.verify()` from genesis first; if an open command reconciles to `not_sent` it writes `failed`, if `completed` it judges and submits T3 or records `plan_rejected` -> `unresolved`, and if `in_flight` or `unknown` it records `unresolved` and blocks new dispatch.
5. Counted-run harness fail-closed gates: `Phase4Runner` (`packages/run-harness/src/phase4/runner.ts`) requires an existing `attempts.json` (`attempt-store.ts`), acquires an exclusive `run.lock`, runs `evaluatePhase4Entry` (`entry.ts`) before any room is created, runs `evaluatePhase4LiveCheck` (`live-check.ts`), executes one label per invocation (`Phase4-CR1`, `Phase4-CR2`, or `Phase4-CR3`), and writes `<label>-<roomId>.record.json` even when the run fails (`FAILED_COUNTED` or `INVALID`).
